title: デビュー戦の後に・ここから！

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I ran as best I could! Phew! What a load off my mi—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: SQUEEEEE!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: JEEPERS!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan A
text_block_list.text: Omigosh, you were amaaazing, Yukino! Did you see that?! She was practically glowing out there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fan B
text_block_list.text: It wasn't just her either—everyone was so bright-eyed and bushy-tailed! So this is what races are like… you really wanna cheer them on!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Whoa… I was not expecting that. Guess she can run after all.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Fans A and B
text_block_list.text: Yukinooo! We're coming to watch you next time too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wow…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I gotta say, seeing people get all giddy watch'n me run feels really good.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y'know… I think I realized someth'n.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I want more of that feel'n. I wanna make folks happy with these legs of mine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right now, they're only int'rested 'cause I'm from the countryside like some of the big racers…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But that's not gonna last forever. It's nice being popular 'n all, but it's gonna taper off sooner or later.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yep, that's what I wanna do. No doubt 'bout it.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: My goal is t'get stronger and get people t'like me 'cause of my runn'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yukino Bijin has a much better grasp of her situation than I expected. But now that she's decided on a personal goal…
choice_data_list: Why don't we decide your racing goals while we're at it?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um! Well… about that…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: No! I shouldn't be mak'n suggestions when I hardly even know my left from right…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But still…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: …Okay!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I… I wanna try my luck at becom'n the Triple Tiara champion!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Triple Tiara champion… A title available only to racers who win three races in the Classics—the Oka Sho, the Japanese Oaks, and the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I sound a li'l loony… I mean, me? A Triple Tiara champion? But…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: When you think of glitz 'n glam… You think of a tiara.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I mean, even the word itself has such a spiffy ring to it. I can't help but want it…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aaaand, winn'n the Triple Tiara'll prove how strong I am! Don't y'think?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Each of the Triple Tiara races attracts many of the year's best runners, and winning is seen as undeniable proof of one's abilities.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It's settled, then!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know it'll be tough t'pull off, but…
choice_data_list: But nothing! You're a great racer!
But nothing! You're a great racer!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aw, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's aim for the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: All right!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: First up's the Oka Sho, right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right, but the Oka Sho is still a ways off. I'd like to set another goal before then. If we follow the standard route, then…
choice_data_list: Why don't we start with the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Hanshin J.F. is a vital G1 race for junior racers. Many who perform well there go on to run spectacularly in the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: City won that race, right? I've watched the video oodles of times!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: And every single time, I imagined myself runn'n like her someday.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Sounds like a plan t'me! Let's take on the Hanshin J.F.!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And just like that, the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies is our next goal.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: So anyway, I'll be tak'n on the Triple Tiara!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Oh wow… Sorry, I don't really know all the races, but that's pretty good, right?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You bet it is! Hm, how can I put this in skat'n terms…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Are there any good skaters over in Nagoya?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: There sure are. Some're top contenders for the world title even!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, the racers runn'n in the Triple Tiara are like that. There'll be eighteen of us all t'gether, try'n our best to win!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Wowie! Sounds like you've got your work cut out for ya!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Y'can say that again! I'm punch'n way above my weight!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: No way that's true! I mean, it's not like y'decided on this path all by yourself.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: If your trainer thinks y'can do it, I'm sure you'll be golden!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, you're right! Trainer praised my runn'n too!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Must be nice…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong, Mifuyu?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Nothing! I gotta stop complain'n about how bad I am at jumps and get myself to the start'n line too!

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Congrats on your debut! Y'know I'm always cheer'n for you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks! I'll be sure t'run my very best at the Hanshin J.F.!
